question: Is the focused test suite plus the available provider-source analysis sufficient for these six bridge contract changes, or must the PR add real-client/provider traces before merge?
rationale: Repository policy explicitly requires provider-native fidelity evidence, while the PR body currently reports tests and static checks but no provider documentation comparison or real-client observations.

options.title: Require focused native proof
options.body: Ask for redacted provider/client traces or authoritative contract references for each changed delivery path and OS-level artifact publication evidence before merge.

options.title: Accept test-backed coverage
options.body: Merge after removing the changelog entry while explicitly accepting that the focused mocks and tests are sufficient evidence for this bridge-only layer.

options.title: Split the validation surface
options.body: Separate artifact security hardening from bridge-contract changes so each risk class can be proven and reviewed independently.

recommendation.title: Require focused native proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted provider/client traces or authoritative contract references for each changed delivery path and OS-level artifact publication evidence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available owner for assembling the provider-contract evidence and narrowing or splitting the proposal if requested.
